info.title: Booking API
info.description: Seven core endpoints plus authenticated booking-request recovery and owner booking history. JSON UTF-8, maximum body 16 KiB. Strict bodies/queries; no type coercion. Prototype-poisoning JSON (__proto__ or constructor.prototype) is rejected during parsing with 400 INVALID_JSON. HTTPS required in production. Every POST requires allowed Origin. Cookie credentials required for protected operations. Rate limits are shared in PostgreSQL in the running server. General 120/min/user (IP for unauthenticated), register 5/15min/IP, login 20/15min/IP plus 10/15min/normalized email. Responses are not cached. Unknown routes return 404 NOT_FOUND. Passwords are Argon2id; session tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes.

post.description: Business timezone Asia/Bangkok. Check-in >= today and <= today + maxAdvanceDays. Checkout > check-in; nights <= maxNights. Defaults 365 advance days and 30 nights; current values are in calendar metadata. Checkout is exclusive. User ID comes only from the session. Database exclusion constraint enforces first committed booking wins. Optional Idempotency-Key UUID is scoped to the authenticated user and retained for the booking lifetime. Same key and normalized body replays the original booking with 201, even after dates/rules change. Same key with different data returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Failed/rolled-back requests do not consume the key. Without the header, legacy overlap rules apply. 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND, 409 ROOM_UNAVAILABLE or BOOKING_CONFLICT. Rate limit 10 attempts/minute/user across sessions.

post.description: No body or query. Session determines owner. Atomic cancellation before check-in day in Asia/Bangkok. Already cancelled returns 200 unchanged, even after check-in. Missing and foreign bookings both return 404 BOOKING_NOT_FOUND; confirmed on/past check-in returns 409 CANCELLATION_NOT_ALLOWED. Keeps history and idempotency key, releases dates after commit. Cancellation quota 10/min/user plus general quota.
